name: gamenet_send_pkt14_hud_timer_and_flags_sync
description: GameNet::SendPkt14_HudTimerAndFlagsSync builds the HUD timer/status synchronization packet and sends it reliably.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Reliable network send is verified through the native fake IDirectPlay4 vtable rather than a live DirectPlay provider.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x434460 validates storing zNetwork::GetLocalPlayerKey into the packet header payload, storing the first fastcall argument into the 16-bit event field, the second fastcall argument into statusFlags, the first stack argument into valueOrTime, and the low word of the second stack argument into auxParam.
BN validates sending g_NetPkt14_HudTimerAndFlagsSyncBuf through zNetwork::SendPacketReliable and returning that result.
The native smoke verifies packet type/size, payload player key, low-word event and aux fields, value/status fields, reliable-send flags, and copied packet bytes.
